records.title: combined source manifest verification
records.failure: The wrapper crossed its projection boundary and lost attributable terminal output.
records.recovery: Audit the process to completion and verify each immutable manifest separately.
records.recurrence_guard: Retain session identifiers and split high-cardinality blob checks by manifest.

records.title: sparse no-checkout index initialization
records.failure: The first sparse set exposed inherited paths as apparent deletions because the new index was empty.
records.recovery: Populate the exact-source index under the installed sparse pattern with read-tree -mu HEAD.
records.recurrence_guard: Require clean status immediately after sparse index materialization.

records.title: planning malformed-candidate uniqueness
records.failure: Removing args from every candidate produced semantic collisions.
records.recovery: Select the first collision-free missing root field while preserving the failed builder.
records.recurrence_guard: Compare actual malformed-request digests; labels do not create novelty.

records.title: privacy URI false-positive aggregate
records.failure: A path regex misclassified public URI scheme fragments as confirmed Windows paths.
records.recovery: Adjudicate exact lines and exclude doubled URI slashes from the path class.
records.recurrence_guard: Keep scanner candidates separate from confirmed payload hits.

records.title: privacy candidate enumeration attribution
records.failure: The first enumeration wrapper finished without a retained terminal projection.
records.recovery: Preserve and poll the returned session identifier through exit.
records.recurrence_guard: Never discard a live bounded process identifier.

records.title: privacy incident self-description
records.failure: A retained diagnostic sentence itself matched the corrected path scanner.
records.recovery: Retain its exact bytes as an incident-definition candidate and use non-path-shaped public wording.
records.recurrence_guard: Allow exact scanner-definition dispositions without promoting them to payload hits.

records.title: symbolic upstream resolution
records.failure: The new branch tracking ref existed, but the repository fetch refspec did not map it for symbolic upstream inference.
records.recovery: Add only the exact owner-branch fetch mapping and re-evaluate all four heads.
records.recurrence_guard: Provision an exact branch fetch refspec before symbolic upstream proof.

records.title: PowerShell configuration summary
records.failure: A native Git command and exit-code expression were combined inside one object expression and failed to parse before any Git query.
records.recovery: Run native commands first, capture scalar exit codes, then construct the summary object.
records.recurrence_guard: Use producer-before-summary sequencing for PowerShell native commands.
